paragraphs: Ascento sells outdoor security patrols carried out by a robot, aimed at organizations that need to keep watch over their own premises. The robot is hired rather than bought outright, as a package fitted to the customer and charged by the hour.

Patrols follow a schedule the customer configures, and the robot carries a payload of thermal, RGB and infrared cameras. Listed rounds include verifying that a perimeter is intact and scanning for thermal anomalies. The unit charges itself and runs for over eight hours on a battery. The company says it works in rain, snow or wind. Live communication with the operator is encrypted, and the robot feeds into video management systems a site already runs.

Ascento presents the whole arrangement as a turnkey package with cost benefits from the start. Installation is said to take hours, with a full service package covering uptime and fast replacements. Support is offered around the clock. The about page describes the staff as experts drawn from different backgrounds and nationalities. Advisors back the team in key focus areas.

quote.text: Detect threats faster with greater accuracy
